description: Reads the public home page of a website and a few pages from its sitemap, the way a search engine does, and returns the SEO problems found (duplicate titles and descriptions, thin content, missing h1, noindex in sitemap, robots.txt, sitemap, http/www variants, compression, mixed content…), the Google snippet as it appears today and where Google cuts it, and the fixes the SEO Records corrector would apply. About 10–20 seconds, nothing is stored. Requires this connector's access pass (€9.90 for 24 hours, or €29 per month). Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants

access_key.description: Access key (pass_…) of this connector, shown after buying its 24-hour pass or monthly subscription. Required.

url.description: The website address, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/
